# Radio group

> Single-choice radio set for plans, filters, and option lists.

This file matches the installed `radio-group` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/radio-group.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/radio-group.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `track-highlight`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/choice-knobs`: `choiceKnobs`, types `ChoiceKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/radio-group`: `RadioGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroupItem`, types `RadioGroupProps`, `RadioProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<RadioGroup>
  <RadioGroupItem>
    <Radio />
  </RadioGroupItem>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { Radio, RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/radio-group";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const plans = [
  { value: "starter", label: "Starter", detail: "1 project, community support" },
  { value: "pro", label: "Pro", detail: "Unlimited projects, priority support" },
  { value: "team", label: "Team", detail: "SSO, audit log, seats" },
];

export function PrimitiveRadioGroupExample() {
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState("pro");

  return (
    <RadioGroup value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan} indicator="hover" aria-label="Billing plan" className="w-full max-w-xs">
      {plans.map((option) => (
        <RadioGroupItem key={option.value} htmlFor={`plan-${option.value}`}>
          <Radio id={`plan-${option.value}`} value={option.value} aria-label={option.label} />
          <span className="flex flex-col">
            <Text weight="medium" tone="foreground">
              {option.label}
            </Text>
            <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
              {option.detail}
            </Text>
          </span>
        </RadioGroupItem>
      ))}
    </RadioGroup>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `radio-group`

  - `label`: `data-choice-kind` (`radio-group`), `data-track-item`
  - `root`: `data-choice-kind` (`radio-group`), `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-track` (`hover` | `none`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### choice

- `--cui-choice-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-choice-indicator-size`: `calc(var(--cui-choice-size) * 0.75)`
- `--cui-choice-radius`: `var(--radius-sm)`
- `--cui-choice-border-color`: `var(--control-boundary)`
- `--cui-choice-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-choice-background`: `var(--control-fill)`
- `--cui-choice-checked-background`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-choice-checked-border-color`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-choice-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
